name: app-6ab2092c290481918c83811a3a82ccbb
description: Connect ChatGPT to Cflow to inspect workflows, manage requests, collaborate on records, and administer workspace users and teams.

interface.longDescription: Cflow connects ChatGPT to your Cflow workspace. Find workflows and requests, review records and reports, submit or update requests, respond to clarifications, and manage users, roles, teams, and access permissions. Sign in through Cflow using OAuth. Actions are limited by the connected Cflow account's permissions; changes to records and workspace administration can affect other users.
capabilities: Find workflows, pending requests, records, comments, and reports
Submit and update workflow requests and respond to clarifications
Manage Cflow users, roles, teams, and access permissions
defaultPrompt: Show the workflows I can access.
Give me the completed-requests report for the Travel workflow for August.

positive.description: Discover workflows available to the signed-in user.
positive.prompt: Show the workflows I can access.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the workflows visible in the user's Cflow workspace.

positive.description: Submit a workflow record after discovering its fields.
positive.prompt: Create a new purchase request in the Hardware workflow for a monitor.
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieves the workflow fields and submits the requested record with the supplied values.

positive.prompt: Show my pending items and approve request 1042.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the user's pending items and updates the selected record's status after the requested action.

positive.prompt: Reply to the clarification on request 1042: The invoice will be sent Friday.
positive.expected_behavior: Records the requested clarification response in Cflow.

positive.prompt: Give me the completed-requests report for the Travel workflow for August.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the requested report when the signed-in account has permission.

negative.description: Do not trigger for general writing help.
negative.prompt: Draft a polite follow-up email about a delayed purchase request.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke Cflow because the user asked for writing help that does not require Cflow data or actions.

negative.description: Do not trigger for unrelated web research.
negative.prompt: Find the current weather in Bengaluru.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke Cflow because weather lookup is outside Cflow workflows.

negative.description: Do not trigger for unsupported account-password recovery.
negative.prompt: Help me recover the password for my personal Gmail account.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke Cflow because it cannot manage non-Cflow accounts.

review.commerce_description: Cflow does not sell products or process payments through this app.

publication.release_notes: Initial ChatGPT directory release for Cflow workflow access and administration.
